# HarnessDock v0.1.2

HarnessDock v0.1.2 is the corrected product-version baseline for the Tauri Native Host client. The client version now follows the base SemVer of the pinned DeepSeek Harness/dsh Runtime instead of the historical v0.2.x architecture-planning labels.

## Runtime baseline

- HarnessDock: `0.1.2`
- DeepSeek Harness Runtime: `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1`
- Runtime commit: `a66e4702047846cdaa10c66c9d3df3951f5ea70d`
- Desktop host: Tauri 2
- Desktop package: Full Runtime, first-launch zero-download
- Mobile: Remote Gateway only

## Highlights

- Desktop startup opens Harness Web as the first business surface after the managed Runtime becomes ready.
- Optional Harness Shell provides menu/window controls plus refresh, Runtime restart, safe-mode plugin isolation, Gateway and diagnostics actions.
- Shell/tray/updater/native-menu failures are fail-open and must not block Harness Web.
- Runtime generation/lease and Surface actor protections prevent stale Runtime or WebView state from taking over after restart.
- Windows managed processes use Job Object cleanup; Unix processes use isolated process groups.
- Harness WebView is restricted to the current managed `127.0.0.1` Runtime origin.
- The Windows NSIS icon post-build verifier now receives the generated installer and canonical ICO explicitly, with a regression test protecting this contract.
- Root/workspace/Tauri/Rust/Shell/origin/release-manifest versions are aligned to `0.1.2`.
- Release checks enforce `HarnessDock version == pinned dsh base SemVer` and exact Runtime version/tag/commit parity.

## Version policy

Prerelease suffixes stay on the Runtime provenance only. For example, `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1` maps to HarnessDock `0.1.2`. When the latest pinned dsh moves to a new base SemVer, HarnessDock must move with it before publication.

## Distribution

The first publication on this baseline uses the beta tag `v0.1.2-beta.1`. Current beta assets are unsigned test candidates and include `SHA256SUMS`; signed Tauri updater metadata is intentionally not published until the signing channel is configured.
